a STRUCTURED result_error (returned value) parses to ok=false — never a silent empty success (ac2)()
an empty result_error string is NOT treated as a failure()
a blank reply parses to ok=false()
over the real parse, a pending list maps to Available with the descriptors()
a top-level object error with a message is tolerated too()
parse with resultErrorIsFailure=false keeps a not-run check's error, checkId and efforts, default parse unchanged()
over the real parse, repo_list's bare array maps to registeredRepos Loaded with the paths()
over the real parse, isProjectRegistered reads the bare-array repo paths()
a BARE ARRAY result parses to ok=true with list, NOT a ClassCastException (repo_list shape)()
